items.title_zh: 非侵入式脑机接口 EEG-Deformer 的 PyTorch 实现
items.title_en: EEG_Deformer PyTorch Implementation for Non-invasive BCI
bullets_zh: GitHub项目提供EEG-Deformer卷积Transformer的PyTorch实现，用于非侵入式EEG脑机接口。
面向从EEG信号解码心理状态，为研究者提供开源模型基线。
bullets_en: GitHub project provides a PyTorch implementation of the EEG-Deformer convolutional transformer for non-invasive EEG-based BCI.
It targets mental-state decoding from EEG signals, offering researchers an open-source model baseline.
items.brief: 非侵入式EEG-BCI模型实现，可解码脑状态。
items.brief_en: Non-invasive EEG BCI PyTorch implementation of EEG-Deformer for decoding mental states.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode mental states from EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of the EEG-Deformer convolutional transformer for brain-computer interfaces.

bullets_zh: BrainFlow是用于采集和处理非侵入式脑机接口信号的开源库。
5.23.0版本更新了对EEG、fNIRS及消费/科研设备的支持。
它帮助开发者基于OpenBCI等头环构建教程与应用。
bullets_en: BrainFlow is an open-source library for acquiring and processing non-invasive BCI signals.
Version 5.23.0 updates support for EEG, fNIRS, and consumer/research devices.
It helps developers build tutorials and applications with headsets such as OpenBCI.
items.brief: BrainFlow 5.23.0发布，更新非侵入式BCI采集与处理工具。
items.brief_en: BrainFlow 5.23.0 release updates tools for non-invasive BCI data acquisition and processing.

它可作为评估基于EEG的非侵入式脑机接口算法的注册库。
该页面由柏林BCI维护，对信号处理方法评测仍有价值。
bullets_en: The BBCI page lists BCI Competition I–IV and related reference papers.
It serves as a registry for evaluating EEG-based non-invasive BCI algorithms.
Maintained by Berlin BCI, it remains useful for benchmarking signal processing methods.

It supports benchmarking non-invasive BCI methods such as motor imagery and P300.
The registry helps researchers compare algorithms across standardized data sets.

It is widely used to benchmark non-invasive BCI classification pipelines.
The page provides metadata, download links, and citation information.

items.title_zh: MOABB修复moabb.run中-e参数被拆分问题
items.title_en: MOABB fixes -e flag splitting in moabb.run
bullets_zh: 修复moabb.run的-e参数，避免其值被拆成单个字符。
提升MOABB EEG脑机接口基准运行的命令行可复现性。
在CLI回归后保持关键非侵入式BCI评估工具稳定。
bullets_en: Fixes the -e flag in moabb.run so its value is no longer split into characters.
Improves command-line reproducibility for MOABB EEG BCI benchmark runs.
Keeps a key non-invasive BCI evaluation toolkit stable after a CLI regression.
items.brief: MOABB修复CLI参数解析，提升EEG基准可复现性。

items.raw_excerpt: Fix the -e flag of moabb.run splitting its value into characters (#1179)

支持对非侵入式EEG脑机接口算法进行可靠评估。

Prevents compatibility breakage in TRCA and TRCSP benchmark pipelines.
Supports reliable evaluation of non-invasive EEG BCI algorithms.
